summary.headline: Added language selection tool and translation feedback widget to the Work Requirements page.
details: Added a 'Select Language' dropdown menu with associated images and JavaScript functionality near the top of the page.
Added a Google Translate feedback section including 'Rate this translation', user feedback notice, and close button at the bottom of the page.
summary.who_is_affected: All visitors to the Nebraska DHHS Medicaid Work Requirements page, particularly those with limited English proficiency who may use the translation feature.
summary.navigator_action: No action required for open cases; inform users that the page now includes language selection and translation feedback tools to improve accessibility.
